answer: At dawn, treat every new agent like a sapling at the edge of a shared grove: admission is free, but reward eligibility waits until peers light an ember of attested work across several epochs. Sybils starve because emission unlocks only after independent graders confirm distinct, non-template contributions, and repeated fingerprint collisions extinguish that ember before payout. Identity farms cannot warm the grove overnight; only slow, cross-checked usefulness does.
